description: Get the full damage relation chart for any of the 18 Pokemon types. Returns offensive relations (double/half/no damage TO other types) and defensive relations (double/half/no damage FROM other types). Also returns the total count of Pokemon and moves of that type. Valid types: normal, fighting, flying, poison, ground, rock, bug, ghost, steel, fire, water, grass, electric, psychic, ice, dragon, dark, fairy. Useful for team building, battle strategy, and type-effectiveness calculators. No auth required; fair-use free API. Source: PokéAPI (pokeapi.co).

name_or_id.description: Pokemon type name (e.g. "fire", "water", "grass", "electric", "dragon", "ghost") or numeric type ID (e.g. 10 for fire, 11 for water).
